sentences.en: See you on the slopes at the crack of dawn!
sentences.zh: 1. 早上见！我们在滑雪坡道上碰面。

sentences.en: We had to go up and down the slopes.
sentences.zh: 2. 我们不得不在山坡上来回走动。

sentences.en: The hill slopes downward to the river.
